caption: Each row is the stack just before one reduction, with the handle marked and the production that replaces it on the left. The first handle is a single id; near the end the whole substring T * F, and then E + T, is one handle.

spec.title: Stacks just before each reduction, parsing id + id * id
spec.aria: Stacks just before each reduction while parsing id + id * id, with the handle marked: id under F → id, F under T → F, id under F → id twice more, then T * F under T → T * F and E + T under E → E + T.
